# Stage 23 per-pattern effect breakdown

Every value and table is POST HOC and descriptive. No pass rule or confirmation applies. No realized outcomes were opened.

D1 repeats the closeout training batch. It is in-sample for weight zero and every corrected-recipe weight, and is not training data for retained CNN-noF or CNN-F. The initial state is untrained. D2 is the response-model validation set used for checkpoint and weight selection. CNN-F has true forcing supplied.
